projects.title: HyperFlow AI Studio
projects.tagline: Real-time AI workflow builder & visual prompt automation canvas.
projects.description: A drag-and-drop web application that empowers teams to assemble, benchmark, and deploy custom multi-model AI agent chains with real-time streaming tokens and visual node graphs.
architecture: React frontend using custom DAG node canvas renderer for agent connections.
Express backend server handling WebSocket token streams & API key encryption.
Local SQLite database for storing execution logs, flow schemas, and prompt history.
features: Visual Node Graph Editor with zoom & pan controls.
Real-time token streaming with syntax highlighting.
Exportable workflow JSON definitions and REST API webhooks.

projects.title: Nexus Realtime Analytics
projects.tagline: High-throughput telemetry & user analytics engine for modern web apps.
projects.description: An end-to-end data analytics suite featuring zero-latency dashboard visualization, session recordings tracking, and automated custom metric alerts.
architecture: Micro-service telemetry collector listening to client event beacons.
Interactive dashboard utilizing CSS custom properties for dark glassmorphism design.
Aggregated time-series SQL database queries optimized with dynamic indexing.
features: Live heatmaps and click telemetry visualization.
Custom SQL filter builder with CSV/JSON export.

projects.title: PulseCloud Infrastructure Monitor
projects.tagline: Lightweight multi-cloud resource health & synthetic performance monitor.
projects.description: A centralized control panel monitoring server health metrics, Docker container CPU/Memory loads, SSL certificate expirations, and latency bottlenecks.
architecture: Background node daemon querying docker sockets and HTTP health endpoints.
REST API serving live metric streams to React dashboard widgets.
Alerting pipeline routing instant notifications to Webhooks.
features: Dark mode dashboard with automated status badges.

projects.title: CodeCraft Live IDE Sandbox
projects.tagline: In-browser collaborative code editor & live preview environment.
projects.description: A lightning-fast web code editor featuring instant HTML/CSS/JS live preview, code linting, dynamic snippet library, and customizable terminal output.
architecture: Client side execution inside isolated WebWorker sandboxes.
Express backend managing snippet sharing links and user collections.
Optimized layout engine supporting tabbed splits and responsive previews.
features: Built-in web console for JS debugging.
One-click sharing with custom URL hashing.
